acceptance_evidence: Web and n8n ordinary users can independently initiate equivalent research over one backend.
Both surfaces expose conclusion, facts, formulas, evidence, limitations and monitoring with clear failure/abstention behavior.
Screenshots, reproducible demo, CI/Docker/E2E and interview narrative are release-ready.
Final Web+n8n human evaluation criteria and denominator rules are frozen before recruitment.
